title: The reunion
summary: Your old school mate has organised a ten-year reunion of your under-sixteens team in the back room of a pub. Half of them work at the club now, in the car park or the shop. A season on, they've got a team again.

ends.title: The old team
ends.text: Your under-sixteens team plays again, on Sundays, in a veterans' league. You turn out when you can. You're still not the best player.

ends.title: The photo
ends.text: You went to your under-sixteens reunion and stood in the photo. You didn't go to the next one.

beats.title: The back room

event.title: The back room
event.speaker: pal
setup: The back room of the Swan. {pal.name} has organised your under-sixteens team's ten-year reunion. Fourteen of the sixteen are here. One stewards in your car park. One works in the club shop. Your old keeper is a dentist.

say: Everybody's looking at you, the one who made it. Somebody says, "Go on, then. What's it like?"

replies.label: Tell them the boring bits too.
"Never mind me. What happened to you lot?"

told.text: You tell them about ice baths and hotel rooms. The dentist says it sounds worse than dentistry. By eleven nobody's asking about football.

asked.text: You hear about kids, mortgages, a divorce, a lottery win of four hundred quid. At midnight the steward from your car park cries about the under-sixteens final and so do two others.

left.text: One drink, the photo, gone by nine. {pal.short} walks you to the car and says it was good of you to come.

beats.hint: Your old mate has organised something

beats.title: Sunday

event.title: Sunday
event.speaker: pal
setup: A season on. {pal.short}: "We've got a team again. Veterans' league, Sundays. The dentist's in goal. Fancy it? Not every week, we know."

choices.label: "Put me down for the first one."

outcomes.text: You play the first one. You lose six-one. The steward from your car park scores the one, and you've never seen anyone happier.
You go. It's a bit awkward. Nobody passes to you. Fair enough.

choices.label: "Can't, mate. The club won't let me."

outcomes.text: "We know. We just wanted to ask." They send you the team photo every week, and you're in every one, photoshopped in, badly.
"No worries." The reunion photo is the last one you're in.
